title: Privacy Policy
content:
[reinforce_legal updated="5 October 2026" lede="How Reinforce Lab collects, uses and protects your information when you use our website, forms and store, and the choices you have."]

Who we are

Reinforce Lab Limited is the company responsible for your information (the "data controller"). Our registered office is Suite #1402, Level-13, Concord Tower, 113 Kazi Nazrul Islam Avenue, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh. We also work from 2511 Pines Pointe Dr, Katy, TX 77493, USA, through our US company, Reinforce Lab Inc.

For anything about privacy, email hello@reinforcelab.com. We have not appointed a data protection officer; your email reaches the people who handle these requests.

What this policy covers

This policy covers our website, our forms, our online store and the emails you send us. When you become a client, the information we handle for you (for example access to your analytics or your website) is covered by our agreement with you.

What we collect

Information you give us

  • Contact form: your name and email address, and, if you choose, your company, website, the topic and your message.
  • Search Authority Diagnostic and SEO & AI Search Audit request form: your name, work email and company, and, if you choose, your website, role, industry, biggest search challenge, monthly content volume and desired outcome.
  • Orders from our store: see "Orders and payments" below.
  • Emails and calls: whatever you choose to tell us when you email or phone us.

Fields marked as required are the minimum we need to reply to you; everything else is optional. Please do not send us sensitive information, such as health information, through the forms.

Information collected automatically

  • Website analytics: if you agree to analytics cookies, we use Google Analytics to understand how the website is used. See "Cookies" below.
  • Visit statistics: we use Jetpack Stats, a service from Automattic, to count visits and see which pages are read. Your browser connects to Automattic's servers, which receive technical information such as your IP address, browser type and the pages you view. We see totals, not who you are. Jetpack Stats does not set cookies on our pages.
  • Fonts: our pages load their fonts from Google Fonts, so your browser connects to Google's servers, which receive your IP address and browser information.
  • Spam protection: when you send a form, we keep a scrambled (hashed) version of your IP address for one hour to limit repeated submissions. It is then deleted automatically.
  • Server logs: our hosting provider, Hostinger, records technical requests (IP address, date and time, page requested) to keep the website running and secure.

Cookies

Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. We use two kinds:

CookieWhat it doesWhen it is setHow long it lasts
Google Analytics (_ga, _ga_*)Tells visits apart so we can see how the website is used, in totalsOnly after you accept analytics cookiesUp to 2 years
Store and login cookies (WooCommerce, WordPress)Keep your cart and checkout working, and keep our team logged inWhen you use the cart or checkout, or log inFrom the end of your visit up to a few days

When you first visit, we ask whether you accept analytics cookies. If you decline, no analytics cookies are set and the website works the same. You can change your choice at any time with the "Cookie settings" link at the bottom of every page, or by clearing cookies in your browser.

Orders and payments

When you buy from our store, we collect what we need to process and deliver your order: your name, email address, phone number, billing address, the products you buy and your order history. Payments are made through our payment provider: you enter your card or payment details on the provider's secure form, the provider processes the payment, and we do not see or store your full card number. We will name our payment provider on this page before the store opens on this website.

We use order information to complete your order, send receipts and updates, handle refunds and support, and keep the records that tax and accounting laws require.

How we use your information

What we doWhy we are allowed to
Reply to your message or requestYou asked us to (steps before a possible contract), and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries
Prepare your Search Authority Diagnostic or audit proposalYou asked us to
Follow up about your requestOur legitimate interest in following up an enquiry you made; you can tell us to stop at any time
Process and deliver store orders, and handle refundsOur contract with you
Measure how the website is used with Google AnalyticsYour consent, which you can withdraw at any time
Keep the website working, secure and free of spamOur legitimate interest in running a safe website
Count visits in totals with Jetpack StatsOur legitimate interest in improving the website
Keep tax and accounting records for orders and clientsLegal obligation

We do not sell your information. We do not use it for advertising, and we do not add you to a newsletter unless you ask to join one. We do not make decisions about you based only on automated processing.

Who we share it with

We share only what each provider needs to do its job for us:

  • Hostinger, which hosts our website and our email, including the hello@reinforcelab.com mailbox that receives form messages;
  • Google (Google Analytics, only with your consent, and Google Fonts) and Automattic (Jetpack Stats), as described above;
  • our payment provider, for store orders;
  • professional advisers, such as accountants or lawyers, when needed;
  • authorities, when the law requires it.

International transfers

Our team works in Bangladesh and the United States, and our service providers may process information in other countries. When information moves between countries, we rely on our providers' safeguards, such as the European Commission's standard contractual clauses where they apply.

How long we keep it

  • Form submissions and emails that do not lead to work: up to 24 months, then deleted.
  • Information about clients and store orders: for as long as we work together or the order needs support, then as long as tax and accounting laws require.
  • Google Analytics data: up to 14 months.
  • Spam-protection records: one hour.

How we protect it

The website uses HTTPS. Form submissions are stored as private records that only our team can open, and access is limited to the people who need it. No method of sending or storing information is completely secure, but we work to protect yours and will tell you and the authorities about a serious breach when the law requires it.

Your rights

Depending on where you live, you can ask us to:

  • tell you what information we hold about you and give you a copy;
  • correct it;
  • delete it;
  • stop or limit how we use it, or object to a use based on our legitimate interests;
  • send it to you or another company in a common format;
  • withdraw consent you gave, at any time, without affecting what we did before.

To make a request, email hello@reinforcelab.com. We will reply within one month and may ask you to confirm who you are. If you are in the European Union or the United Kingdom, you can also complain to your local data protection authority (in the UK, the Information Commissioner's Office).

If you live in the United States: you can ask what we collect and ask us to delete it, as above. We do not sell personal information or share it for targeted advertising.

Children

Our website, store and services are for adults and businesses. We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under 16. If you think a child has sent us information, email us and we will delete it.

Links to other websites

Our pages link to other websites, such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Clutch and the sources we cite. Their own privacy policies apply when you visit them.

Changes to this policy

When we change this policy we update the date at the top of this page. If a change is significant, we will say so here.

Contact us

Reinforce Lab Limited, Suite #1402, Level-13, Concord Tower, 113 Kazi Nazrul Islam Avenue, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh
Reinforce Lab Inc, 2511 Pines Pointe Dr, Katy, TX 77493, USA
Email: hello@reinforcelab.com · Phone: +880 1329-657096 · USA: +1 832 548 4553

[/reinforce_legal]

title: Terms & Conditions
content:
[reinforce_legal updated="5 October 2026" lede="The terms for using the Reinforce Lab website and for businesses buying our service packages online."]

Who we are

The website and store are run by Reinforce Lab Limited, a company registered in Bangladesh, Suite #1402, Level-13, Concord Tower, 113 Kazi Nazrul Islam Avenue, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh ("Reinforce Lab", "we", "us"). Our US company, Reinforce Lab Inc, works from 2511 Pines Pointe Dr, Katy, TX 77493, USA. Email: hello@reinforcelab.com. Phone: +880 1329-657096.

These terms apply when you use reinforcelab.com and when you buy a service package from our online store. Please read them before you place an order.

Using our website

You may read, share and link to our pages, and quote short parts of them with a link back to the page. Please do not:

  • copy, republish or sell large parts of our content, tools or designs without our written permission;
  • try to break, overload or get unauthorised access to the website;
  • use the website or our forms to send spam, malware or unlawful content.

We work to keep the website accurate and available, but we cannot promise it will always be error-free or online. Content on the website is general information, not advice for your specific situation.

Our content and names

The text, diagrams, designs and code on this website belong to Reinforce Lab or are used with permission. "Reinforce Lab" and "Search Authority OS" are our names. Please do not use them in a way that suggests we endorse you or your business without our written permission.

Links to other websites

We link to other websites, such as our sources and our directory profiles. We are not responsible for their content or their privacy practices.

Who can buy from our store

Our store is for businesses. By placing an order you confirm that you are buying for your business, trade or profession, not as a private consumer, and that you are authorised to order for that business.

What you are buying

Our store sells service packages. Each package page describes what is included (for example the number of pages, keyphrases or reports), how long the package runs, and the price. Anything not listed is not included unless we agree it in writing.

Prices, payment and tax

Prices are in US dollars. You pay the full price when you place the order, through our payment provider. We do not see or store your full card number.

Prices do not include taxes, and bank or payment fees in your country are your responsibility unless the package page says otherwise:

  • Clients in Bangladesh: VAT is added at the rate that applies and shown on your invoice.
  • Clients outside Bangladesh: our services are supplied from Bangladesh; where they qualify as exported services, no Bangladesh VAT is charged.
  • Business clients in the European Union or the United Kingdom: please give us your VAT number when you order. Our invoice will show no VAT and say "reverse charge", and you account for the VAT in your own country.
  • Clients in the United States and elsewhere: you are responsible for any sales, use or similar tax that applies to you.

When the contract starts

Placing an order is an offer to buy. A contract starts when we confirm your order by email. We may decline an order, for example if a package is not suitable for your website or the price shown was wrong; if we do, we refund you in full within 7 days.

Starting the work

After your order, we contact you within 2 business days to start onboarding: access to your website and tools, your goals, and any content we need. The timelines on the package page start once we have what we need from you.

Monthly and yearly packages

How long a package runs, and whether it renews, is shown on the package page and at checkout before you pay.

  • Monthly packages renew automatically each month at the same price until you cancel. You can cancel at any time by emailing hello@reinforcelab.com; the package then runs to the end of the month you have paid for, and nothing more is charged.
  • Yearly packages do not renew automatically. We email you 30 days before the year ends with the renewal price, and the package continues only if you confirm and pay.

We tell you at least 30 days in advance before changing the price of a monthly package.

Cancellations and refunds

  • Before work starts: you can cancel within 14 days of your order and get a full refund, as long as onboarding has not started.
  • After work starts: you can cancel at any time. We refund the part of the price for work not yet done, after deducting work already delivered and any third-party costs we have paid for you (for example tools or hosting bought in your name).
  • Delivered work: work that has been delivered (for example a finished audit, written content or a launched website) is not refundable. If it does not match the package description, tell us within 14 days and we will fix it.
  • If we cannot deliver: if we decline your order or cannot start or complete the package, we refund what you paid for work not done.
  • How refunds are paid: to the same payment method you used, within 7 days of the cancellation or our agreement to refund. We pay any cost of sending the refund.

Your part

To deliver the work we need timely access, information and approvals from you. If delays on your side hold up the work for more than 30 days, we may pause the package or close it and keep only the price of the work already done. You confirm that the content and materials you give us are yours to use and do not break anyone's rights.

Results

Search engines and AI tools are run by other companies and change often. We use proven methods and report honestly, but we do not guarantee rankings, traffic, AI citations or revenue, and no one honestly can.

Larger projects

Work agreed through a proposal, statement of work or signed agreement is governed by that document. If it conflicts with these terms, the signed document wins.

Our responsibility to you

We provide the services with reasonable skill and care. To the extent the law allows:

  • we are not responsible for indirect or unforeseeable losses, such as lost profits, lost business or lost data, or for problems caused by search engines, AI tools, hosting providers or other third parties;
  • our total responsibility for any order is limited to the amount you paid for that order in the 12 months before the claim.

Nothing in these terms limits or excludes our responsibility for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud, or for anything else the law does not allow us to limit.

Privacy

How we handle your information is explained in our Privacy Policy.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms. The version on this page when you place an order applies to that order. The date of the last update is shown at the top.

Law and disputes

These terms, and any order, are governed by the laws of Bangladesh.

If a problem comes up, please email us first; we reply within 5 business days and most issues are solved that way. If we cannot resolve it within 30 days, the dispute will be settled by arbitration under the rules of the Bangladesh International Arbitration Centre (BIAC), held in Dhaka, in English, under the Arbitration Act 2001. Bangladesh is a party to the New York Convention, so an award can be enforced in most countries. Either of us may still ask a court for urgent relief, such as an order to protect confidential information.

Contact us

Reinforce Lab Limited, Suite #1402, Level-13, Concord Tower, 113 Kazi Nazrul Islam Avenue, Dhaka 1000, Bangladesh
Reinforce Lab Inc, 2511 Pines Pointe Dr, Katy, TX 77493, USA
Email: hello@reinforcelab.com · Phone: +880 1329-657096 · USA: +1 832 548 4553

[/reinforce_legal]

title: FTC Disclosure
content:
[reinforce_legal updated="5 October 2026" lede="Which links on this website earn us a commission, how we label them, and how we decide what to recommend."]

The short version

Some links on our website are affiliate links to Semrush and WP Engine. If you buy through one of them, we earn a commission, at no extra cost to you. Every affiliate link is marked Ad right next to it, and any page that contains one says so at the top. A commission never decides what we recommend.

Our relationships with the companies we mention

  • Semrush: we are a member of the Semrush affiliate programme and are listed in Semrush's Agency Partners directory. Our founder, Jamil Ahmed, is a Semrush Ambassador.
  • WP Engine: we are a member of the WP Engine affiliate programme and a WP Engine agency partner.

We have no paid relationship with any other company we mention, unless the page says so next to the mention. If that changes, we will update this page and label the content where it appears.

How we label affiliate links

  • Each affiliate link has a small Ad label right after it, so you can see it before you click.
  • A note at the top of the page names the companies the affiliate links go to and links back here.
  • In product lists and reviews, the "Visit" buttons that are affiliate links carry the same Ad label.
  • Affiliate links are marked rel="sponsored" in the page code, as Google asks, so they pass no ranking credit.

How we decide what to recommend

  • We recommend tools because we use them or have tested them for clients, not because of a commission.
  • In reviews we say whether we paid for our own access or the vendor gave it to us free, and vendors do not see a review before it is published.
  • We do not accept payment for reviews, rankings or positive coverage.
  • When a cheaper or free option is a better fit for you, we say so, even if it earns us nothing.

Why we tell you this

You should know when we could earn money from a recommendation, so you can weigh it yourself. In the United States the Federal Trade Commission requires endorsements and affiliate relationships to be disclosed clearly and next to the recommendation; in the United Kingdom the Advertising Standards Authority asks for affiliate content to be labelled as advertising. We apply the same standard to every reader, wherever you are.

Questions

If you are not sure whether a link earns us anything, or you think a label is missing, email hello@reinforcelab.com and we will check and fix it.

[/reinforce_legal]
